basic.name: Behind the Kindness
basic.description_template: Deals Physical DMG equal to {{scaling1}}% of Natasha's ATK to a single enemy.

skill.name: Love, Heal, and Choose
skill.description_template: Restores a single ally for {{scaling1}}% of Natasha's Max HP plus {{scaling2}}. Restores the ally for another {{scaling3}}% of Natasha's Max HP plus {{scaling4}} at the beginning of each turn for 2 turn(s).

ultimate.name: Gift of Rebirth
ultimate.description_template: Heals all allies for {{scaling1}}% of Natasha's Max HP plus {{scaling2}}.

talent.name: Innervation
talent.description_template: When healing allies with HP percentage at 30% or lower, increases Natasha's Outgoing Healing by {{scaling1}}%. This effect also works on continuous healing.

technique.name: Hypnosis Research
technique.description: Immediately attacks the enemy. After entering battle, deals Physical DMG equal to 80% of Natasha's ATK to a random enemy, with a 100% base chance to Weaken all enemies. While Weakened, enemies deal 30% less DMG to allies for 1 turn(s).

2.name: Soothe
2.description: When using Skill, dispels 1 debuff(s) from one designated ally.

6.name: Recuperation
6.description: Increases the duration of Skill's continuous healing effect for 1 turn(s).

eidolons.name: Pharmacology Expertise
eidolons.description: After being attacked, if the current HP percentage is 30% or lower, heals self for 1 time to restore HP by an amount equal to 15% of Max HP plus 400. This effect can only be triggered 1 time per battle.

eidolons.name: Clinical Research
eidolons.description: When Natasha uses her Ultimate, grant continuous healing for 1 turn(s) to allies whose HP percentage is at 30% or lower. And at the beginning of their turn, their HP is restored by an amount equal to 6% of Natasha's Max HP plus 160.

eidolons.name: The Right Cure
eidolons.description: Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.

eidolons.name: Miracle Cure
eidolons.description: After being attacked, regenerates 5 extra Energy.

eidolons.name: Preventive Treatment
eidolons.description: Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15. Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.

eidolons.name: Doctor's Grace
eidolons.description: Natasha's Basic ATK additionally deals Physical DMG equal to 40% of her Max HP.
